name: Crash Safety Semantics
description: With autosave enabled, on crash the model may at worst contain an orphan card that needs to be linked; with autosave disabled, the saved model MUST always be valid and unsaved changes are lost on crash. Since the model is multi-file, atomic writes are not possible; transactional writes MUST be simulated so that if one write in a multi-file operation fails, the entire operation is rolled back.
